caption: The drawing features a single, central object: a vase. The vase has a wide, rounded base that tapers inward before flaring out again to a broad, open mouth. It is depicted in shades of brown, with darker tones dominating the body and lighter, almost reflective spots that suggest gleaming or glossy areas on the surface. There is a small, pinkish chip or spot on the rim of the vase, indicating a possible imperfection or wear. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations, allowing the vase to stand out as the sole subject of the composition.
title: Crockery Flower Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
